name: context-saver
description: Shrinks large shell and MCP tool output before Claude reads it, and shows the tokens saved each time.

model.title: Summary model
model.description: Claude model that summarizes large output: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full model id.

effort.title: Summary effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort of the summary model; none turns thinking off.

summarize_shell.title: Summarize shell output
summarize_shell.description: Send large shell output (search, git, test and build logs) to the summary model when the local filters cannot shrink it.

toast.title: Toast on each save
toast.description: Also pop a toast for each compressed result; the transcript line always shows.
